title: Operation Twin Strike
chips: Twin Cities · the far-left village, a 216 × 378 px cut
lede: Early July 1989, two weeks into the war. A Soviet tank division's forward detachment ({sov:you}) must seize a road-junction village on the western edge of a pair of towns. {nato:NATO} answers twice: a US armoured battalion counter-attacks at once, then a West German Panzer battalion assembles just south of the village for a heavier blow. Soviet doctrine of the day planned nuclear strikes against exactly that, a reserve massing to counter-attack, and Front command offers you release for {nuke:one tactical nuclear strike}. You may also refuse it and fight. **One concentrated battle:** the map is cut to the village and its fields, and everything happens there.

phases.name: Deploy
phases.summary: Buy and place the forward detachment in the north zone.
details: Deck base: RedJuggernaut's 79th Guards Tank Division, topped up by script, with four Ka-29s.
Two FOBs already stand in the zone, placed on the map: no deck can carry one.
The defence cards stay locked until the village falls.

phases.name: Assault
phases.summary: Take the village from its pre-placed West German garrison.
details: The division's 2S7Ms offer one preparation fire on the village, when you call it. Keep your own troops out.
The village falls when the garrison is down to a quarter and a Soviet command unit is inside. The map flips to red.
No fall by 20 min: the battle is lost.

phases.name: Unlock
phases.summary: Front releases the division's reserve: T-80U, Tunguska, Osa, Mi-24, Ka-50, Su-25T, Su-24M.
details: A hint reports NATO recon moving north.

phases.name: Counter-attack
phases.summary: US battalion 1 comes from the south edge on two lanes, recon first, with heavy AA.
details: Fire missions: rockets or heavy guns, then BOX W or BOX C.
Once per battle, the division fire plan: every battery on whichever box holds more NATO vehicles.
It ends when battalion 1 is broken or after 15 min with the village held. Its survivors withdraw.

phases.name: Surprise
phases.summary: A West German Panzer battalion appears at ASSEMBLY, about 5,200 GRU south of the village. It attacks in 05:00.
details: Front asks: request nuclear release, or fight it conventionally.

phases.name: Strike and hold
phases.summary: Released: a 30 s warning, a 2S7M carrier round, the mushroom cloud, and every NATO unit in the zone dies. Hold 5 min.
details: Withheld: battalion 2 attacks north into the village. Hold until it breaks or the village falls, up to 20 min.
Both roads can reach the top grade. The end text names your choice.

marks.title: The forward detachment deploys in the north zone (alliance 0).
Pre-placed garrison: Panzergrenadiere, Marder 1A3, Milan, Leopard 1A5, Gepard, Fernspäher (14).
South across the fields and into the village from the north.
The division's 2S7Ms hit the village once, when you call it. The rockets cannot reach that close.
In an allied AI camp, in the Soviet rear: 2S7M Malka x6, BM-27 Uragan x6. They fire only on your call.
FOB_W: a Soviet FOB, placed on the map in your camp from the start.
FOB_E: a Soviet FOB, placed on the map in your camp from the start.
Ka-29 x4: rocket and gun runs on the garrison. Its one Gepard and the Milans are the threat.
The village is yours: the script forces its owner, and the map shows it red.
Battalion 1's recon screen leads on both lanes: M3A2 Bradley CFV, scouts, OH-58D.
West lane: straight north up the main road, into the village's south side.
Centre lane: up the east road, east of the stream, then west across it into the village. US battalion 1: 30 M1A1HA, Bradleys, heavy AA.
Ka-50 x4, unlocked with the reserve: tank hunting over both lanes, against battalion 1's Vulcans, Chaparrals, Avengers and Stingers.
Fire box on the west lane, about 11,000 GRU from the guns.
Fire box on the centre lane, about 11,800 GRU from the guns.
The nuke zone: radius R, tuned to the effect's size in probe 3.
Battalion 2: Leopard 2A4 x28, Marder 1A3 with Panzergrenadiere x8, Gepard, Roland, Luchs (52).
The carrier round: one 2S7M shell, fired 2 s before the strike.
Released: the game's tactical-nuke effect, then every NATO unit inside the zone dies.
Withheld: battalion 2 attacks north into the village when the countdown runs out.

sections.heading: Order of battle
sections.intro: One counter is one vehicle or squad, at the in-game counts. Every unit is vanilla. Counts are at scale 1×; one knob moves them all. All of it fights inside the 216 × 378 px cut.

footer: The map is the game's own minimap and satellite view, cropped to the op's cut of the stock SM_SU_03 layout (x 0–216, y 146–524 minimap px). The village's command zone is exact, from the stock files; the deployment zones are the op's own boxes. The lanes, boxes and places are drawn by eye.
